svg.title: Split Flap — music video style reference (a3-split-flap)
svg.desc: The whole song on a departure board. Every word arrives by flipping, so no two frames a third of a second apart look the same. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.
svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
The board spins up out of nothing and settles
Three rows, cells flipping wherever the next
Board goes amber-on-red and the crown is drawn
Every cell on the board flips at once,
One row lit, dead centre. Every other cell on
